source_repaired_frontier.finding: each target is correctly excluded from its own factor, but each target therefore receives a different leave-one-out factor; build_pair later compares and ratios those target-specific loadings as if they were coefficients on one common regressor

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: target-specific LOO loadings can change both the relative hedge ratio and the inferred sign relationship versus coefficients estimated on a single pair-excluded common factor

current_live_context.economic_interpretation: current zero fills/completions are not eligible LF execution evidence while the canonical public tape is unhealthy

required_successor_contract: Use target-level leave-one-out factors only as leakage-free screening, not as a common hedge basis.
For every candidate pair, rebuild one factor using controls that exclude both prospective legs; require at least two independent controls or fail closed.
Refit both pair loadings and residuals on that same pair-excluded factor before comparing signs or constructing a hedge ratio.
Recompute null-preserving increment-bootstrap p-values on the pair-refit residuals and apply multiplicity correction over the tested pair hypotheses before economic admission.
Only after a common statistical factor basis exists, convert both exposures to price/PnL units using p*(1-p)*yes_sd*loading as studied in PR 398.
Then apply actual-fidelity n-step/TTR handling and queue-aware same-window joint/partial fill plus abort/unwind economics before threshold aggression.
Do not treat current unhealthy-tape zero-fill observations as economic evidence.
